title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Amar and Prem, who belong to middle-class families, compete to win over Raveena, a millionaire's daughter. Along the way, they run into a local gangster who turns their lives upside down.

title: Mr. India
desc: Hoping to make the world a better place for orphaned children, a compassionate street musician takes on a power-hungry crime boss with the help of a cloaking device.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Satyaprem tries hard to prove himself as a worthy person and restore the faith in the love of Khata, who is overwhelmed by her breakup.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
